karnak.name: Brother Karnak
karnak.flavor_text: A red devil cast out of the Infernal Guard for showing mercy to a damned soul. He carries the contradiction quietly.

serji.name: Serji
serji.flavor_text: The biggest man in the hot hell gym — and the one who walked out. Not because he won, but because winning there stopped meaning anything.

red_peony.name: Red Peony
red_peony.flavor_text: She carries a two-handed club the size of a small tree and moves like she knows exactly how much space she takes up. A lot.

raktamatta.name: Raktamatta
raktamatta.flavor_text: A law-abiding butcher who followed every regulation, filed every permit, and enjoyed his work with a thoroughness that made inspectors nervous.

jawbreaker.name: Jawbreaker
jawbreaker.flavor_text: Fast, reckless, and deeply committed to the principle that the best defence is a fractured orbital bone. Also picks pockets while they're down.

tejasimha.name: Tejasimha
tejasimha.flavor_text: First matches, then houses, then whole districts. He died laughing in a fire he started — hearty, genuine laughter, right to the end.

water_lily.name: Water Lily
water_lily.flavor_text: A village girl drowned as punishment for being found in bed with another girl. She has been very quiet ever since, but her stillness is not grief.

dvijihva.name: Dvijihva
dvijihva.flavor_text: A sorcerer for hire who worked for two rival clients simultaneously, studying both thoroughly. He was killed when they compared notes. He considers this an occupational hazard.

yaga_mataji.name: Yaga Mataji
yaga_mataji.flavor_text: An old innkeeper who poisoned guests she found sinful. Her criteria were specific, her dosing was precise, and she kept excellent records.

niyamendra.name: Niyamendra
niyamendra.flavor_text: Court bureaucrat of a petty king, who found his true calling in the invention of regulations. He can freeze any ordinary process in place — paperwork is eternal.

leraya.name: Leraya
leraya.flavor_text: A huntsman who grew bored with animals and started tracking people instead. The challenge was the point. He is still tracking.

samvibrahmi.name: Samvibrahmi
samvibrahmi.flavor_text: Driven by constant suspicion of assassination, he prepared obsessively for every conceivable threat. He was ultimately killed by a cabbage cart. He still doesn't know how they did it.

vayuvega.name: Vāyuvega
vayuvega.flavor_text: Battle mage for a gang in life — a firm believer in hitting hard first and letting the questions sort themselves out among the survivors.

angulimala.name: Angulimāla
angulimala.flavor_text: Executioner of a crime syndicate, known for a particular professional habit involving fingers. He is fast, precise, and oddly graceful about it.

kanjus.name: Kanjus
kanjus.flavor_text: Owner of a textile manufactory, maximiser of profit, minimiser of worker wellbeing. In hell he applies the same efficiency to whatever operation he finds himself part of.

sarpatailaka.name: Sarpatailaka
sarpatailaka.flavor_text: A trader in snake oil and false cures, who offered hope where real treatment was available. The daggers are for customers who want a refund.

shiny_needle.name: Shiny Needle
shiny_needle.flavor_text: She prided herself on being the prettiest. When age threatened that, she found an elegant solution — draining the lifeforce of rivals through carefully rehearsed enchantments. She called it skincare.

princess_spiderface.name: Princess Spiderface
princess_spiderface.flavor_text: Actually rather nice, though the face doesn't help first impressions. She calls the spirits she summons by name and asks how they've been.

sineater_thirteen.name: Sineater Thirteen
sineater_thirteen.flavor_text: Born from a splinter of dark energy left when a primordial Srid was shattered by a wrathful Buddha. It has absorbed twelve previous identities and is still hungry.

dyutapati.name: Dyūtapati
dyutapati.flavor_text: Owner of a casino in hell — cigar always lit, odds always in his favour, smile always present. The house wins. He is the house.

coolhead_hotblood.name: Coolhead Hotblood
coolhead_hotblood.flavor_text: A people-pleasing librarian who let frustration build in his innards like an alchemical retort. One day the seal broke. He found the experience clarifying.

ayurmangala.name: Ayurmangala
ayurmangala.flavor_text: Fascinated by humanoid anatomy the way a botanist is fascinated by plants. Can be persuaded to forego vivisection of party members — keeping them alive is, after all, a more interesting experiment.

amlamarjari.name: Amlamarjari
amlamarjari.flavor_text: Party girl who found ways to patch up her comrades long after they couldn't go on. Her healing is excellent. Her bedside manner is chaotic.

vimohini.name: Vimohini
vimohini.flavor_text: In life, a mystic whose visions were so vivid that entire communities reshaped themselves around her prophecies. She wasn't lying. She genuinely saw another reality. In hell, the visions have teeth.

tsering.name: Tsering
tsering.flavor_text: Worked every day of his life with diligence and nothing to show for it. No time to rest, no time to reflect. He is still moving, still laboring. He is not entirely sure why.

rasabhava.name: Rasabhava
rasabhava.flavor_text: His formula for eternal preservation was correct in every detail. He finished mixing it the night before he died. He has had some time to consider the timing.

saka.name: Saka
saka.flavor_text: Desiccated by the white salt flats of a desert that keeps its dead well. Still carrying the composite bow he carved from horn and sinew. Still knows which direction the game runs.

mehr.name: Mehr
mehr.flavor_text: Tall, one-eyed, recovered from a tar pit with most of her prophecies intact. The one that failed was accurate. The court simply did not want to hear it.

vilasa.name: Vilasa
vilasa.flavor_text: Boredom is a dangerous condition in a man without constraints and an unshakeable certainty of his own superiority. He passed through every conventional pleasure and kept going. By the end, the only question was what came next.

marmajna.name: Marmajna
marmajna.flavor_text: A physician of genuine skill who understood the body as a system of resources. He began with cadavers. The logic that followed was, he still insists, impeccable. Exactly where the line was — he is still working on that.

kripana.name: Kripana
kripana.flavor_text: A wealthy man who spent nothing, ate little, and wore his clothing until it dissolved. He died sitting on his gold. In the hungry ghost realm, the gold is gone. The hunger is not.

nurse_bones.name: Nurse Bones
nurse_bones.flavor_text: Non-violent by choice. She patches up whoever needs patching up, including enemies, which the party finds occasionally inconvenient.

hustle_bones.name: Hustle Bones
hustle_bones.flavor_text: Has traded his finger joints for better deals, his ribs for bulk discounts, and one femur for something he won't discuss. Still in profit, last he checked.

prashan.name: Prashan
prashan.flavor_text: Spent centuries asking riddles at crossroads. When the charnel grounds ran short of interesting passersby, he went looking for them. He is still looking for the question no one can answer.

temba.name: Temba
temba.flavor_text: Outcast at twelve. Followed at twenty. United the clans at thirty-five through sheer force of demonstrated possibility — showing them what happened when people stopped fighting each other long enough to eat. He never stopped being the outcast kid trying to feed people through a bad winter.

iron_oath.name: Iron Oath
iron_oath.flavor_text: His commanding officer fell in battle three hundred years ago. The order to stand down was never transmitted. He kept his post. He is not pleased about having been relieved of it.

the_chronicler.name: The Chronicler
the_chronicler.flavor_text: Remembers the genealogies of peoples who left no other trace anywhere in the six worlds. Recites them anyway. Someone has to.

nyingje.name: Nyingje
nyingje.flavor_text: Made a vow to remain until every being in this realm found its way out. Still here. Still trying. Probably the oldest being in the charnel grounds, and the least troubled by it.

shantipala.name: Shantipala
shantipala.flavor_text: Brokered peace between enemies by naming what each side secretly needed and daring them to deny it out loud. Now performs the same service at the Skeleton King's copper mirror court, with mixed results.

peldon.name: Peldon
peldon.flavor_text: Ran the village market for forty years. Knew every price, every shortage, every family's circumstances. Indispensable and invisible in equal measure. She finds she cannot stop being useful.

choki.name: Chöki
choki.flavor_text: Left to gather in the forest. Came back to find the village gone — a flash flood, no warning, nothing left. Drowned herself in the same river three days later. Still here, still not sure what she is waiting for.

nangwa.name: Nangwa
nangwa.flavor_text: Died mid-sentence, mid-proof, mid-thought. The argument is almost certainly sound. He just needs a moment to finish it. He has needed this moment for quite some time now.

drupchen.name: Drupchen
drupchen.flavor_text: Performed every ritual, recited every text, accumulated every merit point. Believed none of it. He is in the hungry ghost realm, which he finds philosophically interesting now that he can no longer attribute it to coincidence.

khedrup.name: Khedrup
khedrup.flavor_text: Treated the dharma as a system to be optimized. Found every multiplying formula, every auspicious day, every legitimate shortcut. He preserved himself flawlessly. He is still in the hungry ghost realm. He is reviewing his calculations.

yasha.name: Yasha
yasha.flavor_text: Always one performance away from being truly seen, truly remembered. Still performing. The halls are empty now but the hunger for recognition does not consult the audience.

durvasa.name: Durvasa
durvasa.flavor_text: Professional curse-caster, contract work only, reliable until his final commission. His target had a solid practice of the Devourer of Curses. The invoice was never collected.

gomchen.name: Gomchen
gomchen.flavor_text: A master of ten thousand sutras who found that political dominance within the monastery walls required a different kind of mastery. He acquired it. He was very good at it. He is here.

shesharati.name: Shesharati
shesharati.flavor_text: Reads the tide the way other people read faces, and has stopped pretending this is a metaphor. She left the palace because the court wanted prophecies and she only had weather.

anavatapta.name: Anavatapta
anavatapta.flavor_text: Forty years of naga court administration and not one raised voice. He can find the sentence that ends an argument, and he has never once enjoyed using it.

kambu.name: Kambu
kambu.flavor_text: Held one gap in the reef wall for nineteen years. Nothing got past. He does not consider this an achievement — it was simply his place in this life.

vajradanti.name: Vajradanti
vajradanti.flavor_text: Farms the boiling seams where the water comes up from under the world. Everything she knows about sorcery she worked out alone, at depth, with only the spirits to correct her.

timingila.name: Timingila
timingila.flavor_text: Hunts alone in water where the light does not reach. Speaks rarely and with long pauses, as though surfacing between each sentence.

setubandha.name: Setubandha
setubandha.flavor_text: Walks the line between salt and fresh, deep and shallow, this realm and the next. Claims the boundaries are the only places where anything real happens.

minakshi.name: Minakshi
minakshi.flavor_text: Dances the shoal-turns that keep a school alive — a thousand bodies changing direction as one. Out of the water she is merely extraordinary.

phenaka.name: Phenaka
phenaka.flavor_text: Carries messages up and down four hundred miles of coast and knows every waypoint, every teahouse, and everyone's business. Delivers all of it, whether or not it was the message.

ekadamshtra.name: Ekadamshtra
ekadamshtra.flavor_text: Ran a sounder of forty for thirty years and handed it on cleanly, which almost never happens. Eats last. Sleeps where everyone can see her.

kandali.name: Kandali
kandali.flavor_text: Cultivates the fungal network under nine acres of forest floor and speaks about it the way other people speak about family. Do not step on the nine-year patch.

chitrangada.name: Chitrangada
chitrangada.flavor_text: Drops on things from above and has never once had to explain herself afterwards. Pale as limestone, silent as weather, entirely without malice.

nishkasita.name: Nishkasita
nishkasita.flavor_text: A rakshasa who stopped hunting and started entertaining. His reasons are as mysterious as his past, but some things may be gleaned from how he handles a knife when cutting an onion.

brihannala.name: Brihannala
brihannala.flavor_text: Retired from leading a troop of sixty and now collects stolen objects and unlikely stories with equal enthusiasm. Will trade you either for something you don't know.

phalguna.name: Phalguna
phalguna.flavor_text: Can build anything out of anything given an afternoon and no supervision. Every solution is temporary, every temporary solution has now been load-bearing for six years.

dirghajihva.name: Dirghajihva
dirghajihva.flavor_text: The one the pack looks at before it does anything. She has never given an order in her life; she simply yawns at the right moment and the argument ends.

saramaya.name: Saramaya
saramaya.flavor_text: Walks the ridge lines gathering what grows there and treating whatever she finds hurt. Charges nothing and accepts everything, which balances out about as badly as you would expect.

sthanumati.name: Sthanumati
sthanumati.flavor_text: Maintains the standing stones nobody else remembers the purpose of. She does not know either. She maintains them anyway, on the grounds that somebody clearly meant it.

balavardhana.name: Balavardhana
balavardhana.flavor_text: Holds a thermal over the meadow as his personal fief. Comes down only to settle things, and settles them quickly.

valmika.name: Valmika
valmika.flavor_text: Digs. Braces. Digs again. Has opinions about load-bearing timber that she will share whether or not you have expressed interest in load-bearing timber.

kshudraka.name: Kshudraka
kshudraka.flavor_text: Trades in omens, debts, and things people would rather forget they said. Nocturnal, immaculately polite, and never once has she been the one holding the loss.

tikshnashringa.name: Tikshnashringa
tikshnashringa.flavor_text: Charges in a straight line and meditates on why. Twenty years of practice have not made him stop charging; they have made him extremely precise about when.

nirvikalpa.name: Nirvikalpa
nirvikalpa.flavor_text: Will not eat anything that had a face and will not walk where she cannot see the ground, in case of insects. Weighs two thousand pounds. Has never harmed anything.

madhuvrata.name: Madhuvrata
madhuvrata.flavor_text: One voice in a hive of four thousand, seconded to the surface for reasons the hive has not explained to them either. Sings in three parts by themselves.

agnishikha.name: Agnishikha
agnishikha.flavor_text: Stands facing the sun with his wings spread until sundown, every day, for eleven years. Wants the fire. Does not enter it. That is the whole practice and there is nothing else.
